title: Orange and mustard glazed sausages with eggs on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Sausages, honey, wholegrain mustard, eggs, butter and bread are all ordinary home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a roasting tray, frying pan and grater are needed, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: Eight sausages roasted for 25 minutes at 200°C, with four eggs on four slices of toast, makes a sensible breakfast for four, and the small honey and orange glaze will coat them nicely.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes of active work covers zesting, juicing, turning the sausages, frying the eggs and toasting, and 25 minutes of cooking matches the two roasting stages.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot cooked breakfast suits late January, and orange gives the glaze its name and also comes as wedges on the side.

plain_voice.reason: Clear, plain British instructions with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Sausages, eggs, wholemeal toast and fresh orange make a proper, satisfying family breakfast.
